subjects.rekindled: MID coverage, 50-70% ink. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Silence* (2016), cinematography by Rodrigo Prieto - the Jesuit alone at night at a writing table in the Macau cell. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Put the lamp low and hard LEFT on a plain surface. Leave the whole centre of the frame as bare lit wall. Hang the second, unlit object dead-centre in a shallow recess so the light has to CROSS EMPTY SPACE to reach it. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real oil-lamp physics: a wheel-made clay lamp, wick through a pinched spout, a thin flame leaning as though a breath crossed it; a second unlit clay lamp an arm's length away. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: the lamp flame, moving guttering and leaning toward the unlit lamp. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: both lamps, the ledge, the wall. Do not blur anything. No candles, no glass, no text.
subjects.rekindled-day1-lead: MID coverage, 50-70% ink. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Silence* (2016), cinematography by Rodrigo Prieto - the Jesuit writing alone by lamplight at night. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: One low practical light source at the table edge. The writing surface is the brightest thing in frame. The room behind falls to solid black within a short distance. Detail lives ONLY where the light physically lands. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real scribal physics: a hide scroll under a hand, a reed pen held correctly, EXACTLY five fingers - four plus a thumb, middle longest, thumb low on the inner palm - sheet grain and stitching visible. Conceptual device: the warm golden light comes from BEHIND the parchment, glowing out through the fibres from inside the page rather than falling onto it. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: the light behind the parchment, moving swelling brighter and dimmer, breathing. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the hands, every finger, the reed pen, the scroll edge. Do not blur anything. Scroll stays COMPLETELY BLANK - no letters, characters, script or invented glyphs. No sixth digit, no halo, no text. ABSOLUTE INK CEILING - this is the most important instruction in this prompt and overrides every other consideration: the stated coverage percentage is a HARD MAXIMUM, not a mood. A large proportion of this frame MUST remain warm cream paper carrying only light dot texture. If you are about to fill the frame with dense ink, STOP and leave it as lit cream instead. A frame that is nearly all dark ink is a FAILED print. Darkness must be created by a few small very dark shapes against mostly light paper, never by flooding the whole frame.
subjects.rekindled-day1-mid: AIRY coverage, 25-45% ink. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Lawrence of Arabia* (1962), cinematography by Freddie Young - the desert sunrise, measured: horizon at 81% of frame height, the sun's limb sitting ON the line at 63% across. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Rule the horizon dead straight across at 80% of frame height. One flat unbroken field above. A single small hard-edged light nub sitting ON the line at 60-65% across. The bottom 19% solid, with no detail whatsoever. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real water physics: a dark sea across the bottom, low swells with real weight and direction. Conceptual device: the sea's dot density increases the nearer it gets to that light, as though the water is being printed into existence outward from it. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: the sea surface, moving swelling slowly and settling. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the horizon line, the light nub, the field above. Do not blur anything. No sun disc rays, no stars, no figures, no vessel, no text.

SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Close Encounters of the Third Kind* (1977), cinematography by Vilmos Zsigmond - Barry's abduction - through the door he can see more brilliant light, and drifting smoke. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Camera INSIDE a dark room facing a doorway. Fill the opening with the frame's only pure paper-white. Push visible drifting haze through it toward the lens. Render the interior as one solid ink field with almost no detail, and cut the doorway into it as a clean rectangle of bare paper. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real construction: mud-brick courses, a wooden lintel with visible grain, a worn stone threshold, the door genuinely open on a real pivot. Conceptual device: the light falls OUTWARD across the ground toward the viewer and stops at the viewer's feet - an invitation with nobody standing in it. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: fine dust drifting in the doorway light, moving rising and drifting across the beam. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the door, lintel, brick courses, threshold, the light's hard edge on the floor. Do not blur anything. No figures, no rays, no glow bloom, no text. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Raise the Red Lantern* (1991), cinematography by Zhao Fei - the compound rooftops filling the frame with NO sky, two converging rows. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Shoot at a true 90 degrees, flat to the ground plane, filling the frame edge to edge. No horizon, no sky, never oblique. The arrangement must read as a CHART rather than as a scene. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real anatomy and real ground: the halves of a large butchered animal - recognisable carcass sections with correct ribcage, spine and hide - in two facing rows on dry earth, heavy, casting real contact shadow, an empty aisle between them. Conceptual device: the aisle is untrodden except for a single line of scorch marks burnt down its centre. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: thin smoke off the scorch marks, moving curling upward from the burnt line. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the carcass halves, the dust, the aisle, the scorch line. Do not blur anything. No figures, no gore emphasis, no text.
subjects.rekindled-day2-mid: DENSE coverage, 75-92% ink - HARD CEILING 92%. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Silence* (2016), cinematography by Rodrigo Prieto - a villager holding a burning torch at arm's length on a stony shore at night. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Hold the torch at ARM'S LENGTH so its light rakes SIDEWAYS across broken ground rather than pooling around it. Put the fire ON the ground plane. Let the sky go flat unbroken black with a hard cut-off line. Crowd one corner with a pure-black silhouette so the light reads as PASSING THROUGH rather than resting. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real anatomy: a burning pitch TORCH - a thick wooden stave with a blazing rag-and-pitch head, unmistakably a torch, gripped in a hand - carried low between two rows of recognisable butchered animal halves with correct ribcage and spine. At the right edge a Middle Eastern Semitic man in a woven tunic lies asleep on the earth, dark hair and beard, brown to deep brown skin in DENSE blue halftone clearly darker than any cream, face turned fully away and half hidden by his arm. Conceptual device: the torch lights the halves and the ground brightly but its light STOPS SHORT of the sleeping man, who lies entirely in the dark. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: the torch flame, moving streaming and guttering sideways. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the torch stave and gripping hand, the carcass halves, the sleeping man, the ground. Do not blur anything. No lamp, no second light, no visible face, no pale skin, no text. subjects.rekindled-day2-end: MID coverage, 50-70% ink. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Playtime* (1967), cinematography by Jean Badal and Andreas Winding - the night apartment facade - one black structural beam edge to edge at 42% frame height, separate unrelated activity in lit cells above and below. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Split the frame with ONE hard horizontal band at roughly 40-50% height, edge to edge, solid and unbroken. Run genuinely SEPARATE activity above and below it. Neither half acknowledges the other. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real botany and real soil: below the line, a barley seed genuinely germinating - a true radicle pushing down, a real shoot bending up, correct soil layers, stones, root hairs. Above the line, a Middle Eastern Semitic farmer in a woven tunic asleep on a mat, brown to deep brown skin in dense blue halftone, face turned away. Conceptual device: the underground half is far busier and more alive than the sleeping half above it. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: a small warm golden glow at the seed, moving pulsing slowly brighter and dimmer. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the soil layers, roots, sleeping farmer, the dividing line. Do not blur anything. No cutaway frame, no labels, no arrows, no text.
subjects.rekindled-day3-lead: MID coverage, 50-70% ink. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Nostalghia* (1983), cinematography by Giuseppe Lanci - two cupped hands setting a lit candle stub into a stone ledge at Bagno Vignoni - hands enormous in frame, flame tiny, no face. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Fill the frame with rough stone lit flat and cool from the left. Two cupped hands enter LOW from the right edge. The flame burns INSIDE the cage of the fingers. Light ONLY the fingertips and near knuckles - everything else falls away. No face anywhere. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real anatomy: two Middle Eastern Semitic hands, brown to deep brown skin in dense blue halftone clearly darker than the cream, EXACTLY five fingers each - four fingers plus one thumb, middle longest, little shortest, thumb low on the inner palm - relaxed and curled, never splayed or fanned. A single ember in the hollow between them with real ash and a cracked orange crust. Conceptual device: the ember's light is far stronger than its size should allow. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: the ember's glow, moving brightening and fading as if breathed on. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: both hands, every finger, the ash, the stone. Do not blur anything. No sparks, no flame, no sixth digit, no fused or splayed fingers, no text.
subjects.rekindled-day3-mid: MID coverage, 50-70% ink. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *The Northman* (2022), cinematography by Jarin Blaschke - the wolf-brotherhood rite - figures on all fours across a floor fire, a third standing above on the same axis. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Put the fire ON THE FLOOR at dead centre. Drop the nearest figures so their heads sit BELOW the flame's tip. Stand one figure directly above the fire on the same vertical axis, further back. Everything is lit from below by the fire and nothing else. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real construction and real fire: an uncut fieldstone altar with real courses and soot staining, a genuine wood fire with visible coals and correctly stacked timber. Four Middle Eastern Semitic priests in plain linen along the court, brown to deep brown skin in dense blue halftone, faces obscured by posture and head cloths. Conceptual device: a fifth has broken the row and kneels to lay one more piece of wood on the fire, and the firelight touches only him. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: the flame and its smoke, moving rising and leaning steadily to one side. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the altar stones, all five priests, the timber, the court floor. Do not blur anything. No crowds, no ornate architecture, no gold vessels, no symmetry, no text.
subjects.rekindled-day3-end: AIRY coverage, 25-45% ink. Every quiet region carries a printed dot gradient; never bare flat paper. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Schindler's List* (1993), cinematography by Janusz Kaminski - the Shabbat prologue - a hand holding a match to a wick, hands only, against a black field. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Black field, close in. Catch the instant of transfer, when the two flames are briefly SEPARATE. Only the near knuckles catch light. Hands only - no faces, no bodies, no room. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. NOTE: no verified film still exists of a two-handed lamp handover; this is the closest verified staging and is adapted deliberately. Ground it in real anatomy: a wheel-made clay lamp with a pinched spout and real wick, held by a young Middle Eastern Semitic man, brown to deep brown skin in dense blue halftone, only hands and forearms in frame, EXACTLY five fingers - four plus a thumb, curled around the lamp, never fanned. An older woman's deeply lined hands, same skin rendering, are withdrawing at the frame's edge, clearly leaving. Conceptual device: the lamp is lit and the older hands are already going, so the flame belongs to neither pair at this instant. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: the lamp flame, moving leaning and recovering as the lamp changes hands. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: both pairs of hands, every finger, the clay lamp body. Do not blur anything. No faces, no full figures, no sixth digit, no splayed fingers, no flat empty paper, no text. A large proportion of this frame MUST remain warm cream paper carrying only light dot texture. If you are about to fill the frame with dense ink, STOP and leave it as lit cream instead. subjects.rekindled-day4-lead: MID coverage, 50-70% ink. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Satantango* (1994), cinematography by Gabor Medvigy - the eagle-owl on a pierced masonry screen against total black, far flank dissolved into the ground. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: One animal in the RIGHT THIRD against pure black with nothing behind it. One soft light from front-left. Let the far flank vanish ENTIRELY into the ground so the animal is only half-described. Rest it on a low masonry ledge catching the same light. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real animal anatomy and real fire: a young lamb on real hooves with correct wool texture and a real cast shadow, near a low stone altar with a genuine banked fire and visible coals. Conceptual device: the lamb stands calmly on the WARM side of the fire, plainly being warmed by it rather than brought to it. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: the lamb's fleece and the low flame, moving stirring together in the heat draft. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the lamb's body and legs, the altar stones, the floor. Do not blur anything. No knife, no rope, no emphasised horns, no blood, no figures, no text.
subjects.rekindled-day4-mid: AIRY coverage, 25-45% ink. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *Days of Heaven* (1978), cinematography by Nestor Almendros - Abby walking toward the Farmer's house at magic hour, a bundle in her arms. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: Two solid black shapes at opposite thirds on ONE flat backlit field. The carried bundle survives only as a LUMP IN THE SILHOUETTE, never as texture. The only bright detail anywhere is tiny punched-out openings in the larger mass. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real anatomy and real terrain: a single Middle Eastern Semitic shepherd, small but clearly readable, in woven tunic and draped mantle with a head cloth, brown to deep brown skin in dense blue halftone, on a real hill path, carrying a lamb held correctly in the fold of his mantle, face turned away. Conceptual device: the lamb is asleep and the shepherd does all the walking; a low sun behind them makes their two outlines read as one shape. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: the trailing edge of the mantle and head cloth, moving lifting and settling in a steady wind. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the shepherd, the sleeping lamb, the hill line, the sun. Do not blur anything. No raised staff, no flock, no dog, no rays, no text.
subjects.rekindled-day4-end: DENSE coverage, 75-92% ink - HARD CEILING 92%. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *The Return* (2003), cinematography by Mikhail Krichman - a small fire on open sand at the water's edge, figures backs-to-camera and tiny. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: High horizon at the TOP THIRD. A small low fire on open sand beneath a solid black treeline. The seated figure backs-to-camera and small. Give the bottom two-thirds to flat empty sand. Run one near-black horizontal bar across the very bottom as a foreground anchor. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real fire and real coastline: a charcoal fire low on wet sand with real coals, fish laid on stones beside it, a beached wooden boat with correct hull construction. A single Middle Eastern Semitic man sits at the fire in a woven tunic, brown to deep brown skin in dense blue halftone, seen from behind. Conceptual device: two places are set at the fire and only one man is sitting, and the coals light the empty place more brightly than the occupied one. MOTION - this becomes a cinemagraph, so exactly ONE thing moves: smoke off the coals and the shallow water at the sand's edge, moving smoke drifting sideways, water sliding up and back. Leave open space in that direction. All else is a hard static anchor, crisp and still: the seated man, the boat, the fish, the stones. Do not blur anything. No second figure, no halo, no text.
subjects.rekindled-day5-lead: DENSE coverage, 75-92% ink - HARD CEILING 92%. SHOT REFERENCE - stage this frame after a real film still: *The Others* (2001), cinematography by Javier Aguirresarobe - a child prone on the floor of a vast dark music room, a floor lamp beside her, a dying grate on the far wall. STEAL EXACTLY THIS: From high and slightly behind: the child flat on the floor, SMALL and central, in a vast dark room. A small lamp on the boards beside her. Give the bottom half of the frame to nothing but floor. Take both side walls and the ceiling to SOLID BLACK. Inherit the staging, the light logic and the value structure only; subject, period and two-ink riso printing stay as described here. Ground it in real construction and real anatomy: heavy woven curtains with real weight and fall, a stone floor, a standing bronze lampstand with a real oil reservoir and a wick burnt down almost to nothing.
